Open source ecosystem microblog udpate:

My email client app - K9 Mail - has better tools for unsubscribing from junk mail than I encountered in either Outlook or Proton mail.

I once tolerated worse software more thoughtfully written, in order to use open source.

Now I simply enjoy better software.

I should have expected this. Shared source ratchets slowly but inexorably through improvements, and some software problems just aren't that difficult when there's no need to enshitify for a quarterly earnings report.

#android #fdroid #opensource
